resources.string: Test 2: hardware-gated driver-state filtering, native GLES and bounded shader cache. Enabled by default for new configurations; restart the game.

Test 2 requested: nine redundant driver-state calls can be filtered per context. Native GLES, FSR1 off, GPU timer queries off and 64–128 MiB cache. Stored manual choices return when disabled. Activation and submitted/forwarded/skipped counters appear in MG/latest.log.

Test 2 filters identical valid viewport, scissor, depth, culling and clear-state assignments at the driver dispatch boundary. It never skips draws or synchronization, and does not alter shader precision. Untracked contexts and invalid inputs are forwarded. This can reduce CPU driver overhead, but does not make GPU-heavy shaders cheaper or guarantee an FPS gain. Native GLES, FSR1 off, timer queries off and 64–128 MiB GLSL cache are runtime overrides only. Restart the game after changing this option.
Not implemented in this experimental build: no validated AI interpolation pipeline or model is integrated. FSR1 is spatial upscaling, not AI frame generation.
Use once for a configuration inherited from Test 1. Replaces known rendering settings after confirmation; unknown keys are preserved.

Replace current rendering settings with G99 defaults? Native GLES preference, no error suppression, automatic GL version, 64 MiB GLSL cache, compute/timer/DSA extensions off, FSR1 off, capability-filtered default multi-draw order and Helio G99 Test on. This resets custom multi-draw rankings too. Unknown JSON keys remain. Back up MG/config.json if you want your old manual settings. Restart the game afterward.
